terms.title: Iswi
terms.body: Isemli-a yesskan taɣessa n wakud n tuqqna n tiwtilin n useqdec n AWA.

terms.title: Aseqdec n usnas
terms.body: AWA d-yettak ifecka n uḍfar udmawan d tezmert. Agbur ufrin ara yesfeḍ izerfan d tegdilin n yiseqdacen ad yettwarnu ticki tfukk usentem usḍris.

terms.title: Tuƣalin n ugmuḍ
terms.body: Tiwtilin tufrinin i yeqqnen ɣer tuɣalin, ameẓlu d usnerni n ugmuḍ mazal ttwaɛeddant ad ttwasentemant.

terms.title: Anermis
terms.body: Isalan n unermis ofisyal ad ttwarnun ticki ad ttwasentmen sɣur tarbaɛt n AWA.

privacy.title: Isefka i yeqqnen
privacy.body: Aḥric-a ad d-yessemɣer s wudem ummid isefka i yettwaxdamen sɣur AWA d uswir-nsen, ticki tfukk usentem usḍris.

privacy.title: Aklas d tɣellist
privacy.body: Isemli ufrin ad d-yesbeggen iswiren n uklas, n ukcam d tallit n uḥrez.

privacy.title: Izerfan-ik
privacy.body: Iswiren n unekcum, n uswever neɣ n tukksa n yisefka-inek ad d-ttwabdarent deg lqem yettwasentmen.

privacy.title: Anermis n tbaḍnit
privacy.body: Tansa tuffirt n unermis n unemhal n tbaḍnit ad tettwarna send usuffeɣ.
